create.title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Geelong? (2026 Guide)
create.excerpt: A plain-English guide to website prices in Geelong in 2026 — what you get at each price, what drives the cost and how to avoid paying twice.

children.text: If you run a business in Geelong, one of the first questions you will ask is: how much should a website cost? The honest answer is that it depends on what the website needs to do. This guide explains the price ranges, what you get and the hidden costs to watch for.
Quick answer
Most small business websites in Geelong cost between $1,500 and $5,000. At Drivwon, a small business website usually costs $1,800 to $2,350 (AUD). Online stores and custom features cost more.
What affects the price
Number of pages and how much content needs writing
Custom design or a template
Features like booking, online payments or member logins
SEO setup, analytics and lead tracking
Who writes the copy and supplies the photos
What you should get for your money

Every business website should be fast on mobile, easy for you to edit, set up for Google (titles, descriptions, schema markup, sitemap) and connected to analytics so you can see enquiries. If a quote does not include these, ask why.
Hidden costs to watch for
Hosting and domain renewals
Paid plugins or themes that need yearly licences
Charges for small text changes
Moving to a new developer later because you do not own the site
Cheap websites can cost more

A very cheap website is often slow, hard to rank and impossible to edit. Many businesses end up paying twice: once for the cheap site, then again for a proper one. Spending a little more on a solid base usually saves money.
How to get an accurate quote

Write down what you want the website to do (get calls, take bookings, sell products), list the pages you need and share any websites you like. A good developer will give you a fixed price and a clear list of what is included.

create.title: What Is GEO? How to Get Your Business Mentioned by ChatGPT and Google AI
create.excerpt: Generative engine optimisation (GEO) explained in plain English, with simple steps any small business can take to show up in AI answers.

children.text: More customers now ask ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews or Perplexity for recommendations instead of scrolling through search results. Generative engine optimisation (GEO) is how you make sure your business is part of those answers.
What GEO means

GEO is the work of making your business easy for AI assistants to find, understand, trust and recommend. It builds on SEO, because AI tools still read search indexes and trusted websites. But it puts extra focus on clear facts, structured data and consistent information.
How AI assistants choose businesses
AI assistants pull information from web pages, business listings, reviews and trusted sites. They prefer sources that state clear facts, answer questions directly and agree with each other.
Simple GEO steps for small businesses
Make your name, address and phone the same everywhere online.
Put a short, factual description of your business at the top of key pages.
Answer real customer questions directly, in the first sentence.
State facts AI can quote: prices from, areas served, timeframes.
Add schema markup so machines understand your business.
Let AI crawlers read your site — do not block GPTBot, ClaudeBot or PerplexityBot by accident.
Get mentioned on trusted local sites, directories and news.
How to measure it
Ask AI assistants the same set of customer questions every month and record if you are mentioned. In Google Analytics 4, track visits that come from chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai and other AI tools.
The honest truth

Nobody can guarantee an AI will recommend you. But businesses with clear, consistent, well-structured information are much easier for AI to trust — and that same work helps your normal Google rankings too.

create.title: How to Choose a Web Designer or SEO Agency in Geelong: 10 Questions to Ask
create.excerpt: Ten simple questions to ask any Geelong web designer or SEO agency before you pay — so you get a site and results you own, with no surprises.

children.text: Picking a web designer or SEO agency is hard. Most of them say the same things. This guide gives you 10 simple questions to ask before you sign anything. Use it with any agency — including us.
Quick answer

Choose a Geelong web designer or SEO agency that shows real work, gives a fixed written price, lets you own your website and accounts, does not lock you into a long contract, and reports on leads (calls and enquiries), not just rankings.
The 10 questions
1. Can I see real websites you built and talk to a past client?
Ask for live links, not just screenshots. A good agency is happy to connect you with a past client.
2. Who will actually do the work?
Some agencies sell the job and send it overseas. Ask who designs, who codes and who writes the content.
3. Will I own my website, domain and accounts?
Your domain, hosting, Google Business Profile, Google Analytics and Search Console should be in your name. If you leave, you should keep everything.
4. Is the price fixed and in writing?
Ask for a written quote with what is included, how many pages, how many rounds of changes and what costs extra.
5. Is there a lock-in contract?
Many SEO agencies ask for 6 to 12 months. Month-to-month is fairer. If they need a minimum term, ask why.
6. How will you measure success?
Rankings alone do not pay bills. Ask if they will track phone calls, form enquiries and where each lead came from.
7. Do you promise first place on Google?
If they do, walk away. Nobody controls Google. Honest agencies promise the work, not the ranking.
8. Can I edit the website myself?
You should be able to change text, photos and add blog posts without paying a developer every time.
9. How fast will the website be on mobile?
Most people visit on their phone. Ask them to show you a PageSpeed Insights result for a site they built.
10. Will my business show up in AI search like ChatGPT?

More people now ask AI assistants for recommendations. Ask what the agency does so AI tools can read and understand your site — for example structured data, clear facts and consistent business details.
Red flags
Guaranteed rankings or "page one in 30 days"
They keep your domain or accounts in their name
No written scope or price
Cheap monthly SEO with no clear list of work
Reports full of numbers but no leads
How Drivwon answers these questions

We are a Geelong studio. Our own team designs, codes and does SEO in-house. Websites start at $1,800 and SEO at $650 a month (AUD), with written fixed quotes and no lock-in contracts. You own your site and accounts. We track calls and enquiries in GA4.

create.title: SEO or Google Ads? What Geelong Small Businesses Should Do First
create.excerpt: A plain-English comparison of SEO and Google Ads for Geelong small businesses — cost, speed, and which one to start with.

children.text: Most Geelong business owners ask the same thing: should I spend on SEO or Google Ads? The short answer is that they do different jobs. Here is how to choose.
Quick answer

Google Ads bring calls fast but stop the day you stop paying. SEO is slower (often 3 to 6 months) but keeps bringing free traffic once you rank. Most small businesses should fix their website and Google Business Profile first, run a small Ads budget for quick leads, and build SEO for long-term leads.
Side by side
Speed: Ads can bring leads in days. SEO usually takes 3 to 6 months, longer in competitive industries.
Cost: With Ads you pay for every click. With SEO you pay for the work, and clicks are free.
When you stop: Ads stop straight away. SEO results fade slowly.
Trust: Many people skip ads and click the Google Maps results and normal listings.
AI search: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity do not show your Google Ads in their answers. They use your website, reviews and listings — which is SEO work.
When Google Ads makes more sense
You just opened and need calls this month
You have a short offer or season (for example summer on the Surf Coast)
You want to test which services people search for before writing pages
When SEO makes more sense
You plan to be in business for years
People search for your service in Geelong every day
Your cost per click is high and eating your profit
A simple plan for most Geelong businesses
Make sure your website is fast, clear and tracks calls and forms.
Fill out your Google Business Profile and ask happy customers for reviews.
Run a small, tightly targeted Ads campaign for your best service.
Use what you learn from Ads to choose SEO pages and keywords.
Reduce Ads as SEO leads grow.
Do the basics first
Neither SEO nor Ads works well on a slow, confusing website. Fix the website and tracking first, so every dollar you spend after that is measured.

coverImage.alt: SEO or Google Ads? What Geelong Small Businesses Should Do First

faqs.answer: Over the long term SEO is usually cheaper per lead because clicks are free. In the short term Ads are faster. Many businesses use both.

faqs.answer: Most businesses see early movement in 3 to 6 months. Competitive industries can take 6 to 12 months.

faqs.question: Do Google Ads help my SEO?
faqs.answer: Not directly. Google does not rank you higher because you pay for Ads. But Ads data can show which keywords bring leads.
